No, not for real tests. My notes record the rule as: no long, wasteful or repeated CI, but real tests that prove something stay. A run repeats only when the code under it changed, and the number of delegates is not a target. So I may cut repetition and waste (checks run once per tree, via `checkOnce`), but I may not cancel or drop a test that actually proves something. I also can't edit owner-rules.md for this.

My notes don't hold his exact words from late 10-15, or the specific run he complained about. I'd be guessing if I quoted him.
